ruleDefinitions.name: Suspicious Execution Location Of Wermgr.EXE
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects suspicious Windows Error Reporting manager (wermgr.exe) execution location.

sequences.query: process_path = RGX("\\\\wermgr\\\.exe$") AND  NOT ((process_path = RGX("^C\\:\\\\Windows\\\\System32\\\\") OR process_path = RGX("^C\\:\\\\Windows\\\\SysWOW64\\\\") OR process_path = RGX("^C\\:\\\\Windows\\\\WinSxS\\\\")))
